verses.sanskrit:
लोमश उवाच।
              तं दृष्ट्वा घोरवदनं मदं देवः शतक्रतुः। आयान्तं भक्षयिष्यन्तं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्॥१॥
verses.english: Lomasha said: Having seen the fearful-faced Mada, coming with open mouth like death himself with the intention of devouring him, the deity Shatakratu (Indra).

verses.sanskrit: भयात्संस्तम्भितभुजः सृक्किणी लेलिहन्मुहुः। ततोऽब्रवीद्देवराजश्च्यवनं भयपीडितः॥२॥
verses.english: Licked the corner of his mouth when his arms were paralyzed. Being afflicted with fear, the celestials king thus spoke, O son of Bhrigu, O Brahmanas, I truly tell you that from this day the two Ashvins will be entitled to receive the Soma juice. Therefore be merciful to me.

verses.sanskrit: सोमार्हावश्विनावेतावद्यप्रभृति भार्गव। भविष्यतः सत्यमेतद्वचो विप्र प्रसीद मे॥३॥
न ते मिथ्या समारम्भो भवत्वेष परो विधिः। जानामि चाहं विप्रर्षे न मिथ्या त्वं करिष्यसि॥४॥
verses.english: O Brahmana Rishi, your attempts can never be futile. Let this be the rule. I know your act can never be in vain.

verses.sanskrit: सोमार्हावश्विनावेतौ यथा वाद्य कृतौ त्वया। भूय एव तु ते वीर्यं प्रकाशेदिति भार्गव॥५॥
verses.english: O son of Bhrigu, these two Ashvins are now entitled to drink the Soma juice as you have made them today. O son of Bhrigu, I have done it to spread the fame of your powers.

verses.sanskrit: सुकन्यायाः पितुश्चास्य लोके कीर्तिः प्रथेदिति। अतो मयैतद्विहितं तव वीर्यप्रकाशनम्॥६॥
verses.english: My object was to spread the fame of the father of Sukanya all over the world. It has been done by me, so that your fame may spread.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रसादं कुरु मे भवत्वेवं यथेच्छसि। एवमुक्तस्य शक्रेण भार्गवस्य महात्मनः॥७॥
verses.english: Therefore be merciful to me. Let it be as you desire." Having been thus addressed by Indra, the high-souled son of Bhrigu.

verses.sanskrit: स मन्युर्व्यगमच्छीघ्रं मुमोच च पुरंदरम्। मदं च व्यभजद्राजन्पाने स्त्रीषु च वीर्यवान्॥८॥
verses.english: Was soon appeased; and he set free Purandara (Indra). O king, that mighty Rishi distributed Mada and put it piece-meal in drinks, in women, in gambling and in the field of sports. This Mada was formerly created again and again. Having thus thrown away Mada, he adored Indra with Soma.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षेषु मृगयायां च पूर्वसृष्टं पुनः पुनः। तदा मदं विनिक्षिप्य शक्रं संतर्प्य चेन्दुना॥९॥
अश्विभ्यां सहितान्देवान्याजयित्वा च तं नृपम्। विख्याप्य वीर्यं लोकेषु सर्वेषु वदतां वरः॥१०॥
verses.english: He then assisted that king (Sharyati) to perform sacrifices to all the celestials together with the Ashvins. That foremost of speakers thus spread his fame all over the world.

verses.sanskrit: सुकन्यया सहारण्ये विजहारानुकूलया। तस्यैतद्द्विजसंघुष्टं सरो राजन्प्रकाशते॥११॥
verses.english: O king, he then happily lived with his loving wife Sukanya in the forest. This is, O king, his lake resounding with the voice of the birds.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र त्वं सह सोदर्यैः पितॄन्देवांश्च तर्पय। एतद्दृष्ट्वा महीपाल सिकताक्षं च भारत॥१२॥
verses.english: You must with you brothers offer oblations here to the Pitris and the celestials. O ruler of earth, O descendant of Bharata, having seen it and Sikataksha, you should then go to the Saindhava forest and see many artificial rivers there. O great king, you should touch the waters of all the currents there and then, O descendant of Bharata, uttering the mantras of Sthanu, you will attain to ascetic success. O foremost of men, it is the time of junction between Treta and Dvapara Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: सैन्धवारण्यमासाद्य कुल्यानां कुरु दर्शनम्। पुष्करेषु महाराज सर्वेषु च जलं स्पृश॥१३॥
स्थाणोर्मन्त्राणि च जपन्सिद्धिं प्राप्स्यसि भारत। संधिर्द्वयोर्नरश्रेष्ठ त्रेताया द्वापरस्य च॥१४॥
अयं हि दृश्यते पार्थ सर्वपापप्रणाशनः। अत्रोपस्पृश्य चैव त्वं सर्वपापप्रणाशने॥१५॥
verses.english: O son of Pritha, by seeing it, one is cleansed of all his sins. Perform your oblations here in this place which is capable of destroying all sins.
verses.bhavadeepa: सन्धिर्द्वयोरिति । संप्रति कलिद्वापरसन्धावपि अत्र तीर्थे त्रेताद्वापरसन्धितुल्यः कालोऽस्ति अत्र स्नातानां कलिस्पर्शो नास्तीति भावः ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: आर्चीकपर्वतश्चैव निवासो वै मनीषिणाम्। सदाफलः सदास्त्रोतो मरुतां स्थानमुत्तमम्॥१६॥
verses.english: Yonder is the Archika hill, inhabited by cultured men. Fruits of all seasons grow here at all times and the streams run forever. It is an excellent place.

verses.sanskrit: चैत्याश्चैते बहुविधास्त्रिदशानां युधिष्ठिर। एतच्चन्द्रमसस्तीर्थमृषयः पर्युपासते। वैखानसा वालखिल्याः पावका वायुभोजनाः॥१७॥
verses.english: O Yudhishthira, there are may caverns here of various forms made by the celestials. This is the Tirtha of the moon and it is surrounded on all sides by the Rishis, who are the Vaisyas, the Valkhilyas, the Pavakas and the Vayuvakhas.

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गाणि त्रीणि पुण्यानि त्रीणि प्रस्रवणानि च। सर्वाण्यनुपरिक्रम्य यथाकाममुपस्पृश॥१८॥
verses.english: There are three peaks and three sacred springs; you may walk round them all one by one; you can perform your oblations at pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तनुश्चात्र राजेन्द्र शुनकश्च नराधिपः। नरनारायणौ चोभौ स्थानं प्राप्ताः सनातनम्॥१९॥। इह नित्यशया देवाः पितरश्च महर्षिभिः। आर्चीकपर्वते तेषुस्तान्यजस्व युधिष्ठिर॥२०॥
verses.english: O king of kings, O ruler of men, Santanu, Sanaka and Nara and Narayana, have obtained eternal regions from this place.
verses.bhavadeepa: त्रीणि शृङ्गाणीति । प्राग्व्याख्यातरीत्या त्रिकोणं वाराणसीक्षेत्रम् । त्रीणि प्रस्रवणानीति च प्रयागम् । एतानि सर्वाणि अनुपरिक्रम्य प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य यथाकाममिह स्नाहि । यथाकाममित्यस्य काशीप्रयागसेविनां चन्द्रतीर्थसेवनमैच्छिकम् इतरेषामत्यावश्यकमिति भावः । गौडास्तु ‘त्रीणि शृङ्गाणि शुभ्राणि त्रीणि प्रस्रवणानि च । पुष्कराण्यादिसिद्धानि न विद्मस्तत्र कारणम्’ इति श्लोकमत्रापि पठन्ति स च प्रागेव व्याख्यातः । अत्र पाठस्तु काश्यादिस्तुत्या पूर्वोक्तार्थस्य दृढीकारार्थः ॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: इह ते वै चरून्प्राश्नन्नृषयश्च विशांपते। यमुना चाक्षयस्स्रोता कृष्णश्चेह तपोरतः॥२१॥
verses.english: O king, here did they cook charu (rice with milk) with the Rishis; here is also the Yamuna of everlasting current where Krishna engaged himself in asceticism.
verses.bhavadeepa: नित्यशयाः नित्यं शयानाः संनिहिता इत्यर्थः । तेपुस्तपश्चक्रुः ॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: यमौ च भीमसेनश्च कृष्णा चामित्रकर्शन। सर्वे चात्र गमिष्यामस्त्वयैव सह पाण्डव॥२२॥
verses.english: O son of Pandu, O chastiser of foes, the twins, Bhimasena and Krishna (Draupadi) and all of us will accompany you to this spot,

verses.sanskrit: एतत्प्रस्त्रवणं पुण्यमिन्द्रस्य मनुजेश्वर। यत्र धाता विधाता च वरुणश्चोर्ध्वमागताः॥२३॥
verses.english: O ruler of men, this is the sacred spring of Indra where Dhata, Vidhata and Varuna rose upwards.

verses.sanskrit: इह तेऽप्यवसन्राजन्क्षान्ताः परमधर्मिणः। मैत्राणामृजुबुद्धीनामयं गिरिवरः शुभः॥२४॥
verses.english: O king, here do they live observing forbearance and practising the greatest virtue. This excellent and auspicious mountain is fit for kind and can did persons.

verses.sanskrit: एषा सा यमुना राजन्महर्षिगणसेविता। नानायज्ञचिता राजन्पुण्या पापभयापहा॥२५॥
verses.english: This is that Yamuna, O king which is frequented by the great Rishis, the scene of many sacrifices, it is holy and it destroys all fear of sin.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र राजा महेष्वासो मांधातायजत स्वयम्। साहदेविश्च कौन्तेय सोमको ददतां वरः॥२६॥
verses.english: son of Kunti, here did the great bow-man, king Mandhata, himself perform sacrifices, so did also Somaka, the son of Sahadeva, that foremost of all boon-givers.
